description: A file encoded in UTF-16 is an error
notes: RFC 7159 says JSON text is encoded in UTF-8, UTF-16 or UTF-32 (section 8.1), and the spec adopts it without choosing an encoding. hashicorp/hcl only reads UTF-8: in UTF-16 the NUL byte after the opening brace is an invalid token (scan in json/scanner.go).
